In the DX New-Build Real Estate Business, it will advance branding with income property development as the main focus; in the DX Renovation Real Estate Business, it will focus on the high-price segment centered on the "Premium Renovation" series priced at ¥100 million or more; in the DX Real Estate Value Enhancement Business, it will aim to create value through land development and land planning and existing properties; and in the Real Estate Leasing Business, it will aim to secure stable revenue through investment in healthcare facilities and optimization of its rental portfolio.
